items.title: Imperial Teen Announce New Album All Over You: Hear “Overdrive”
items.summary: It's been seven years since Imperial Teen's last album, Now We Are Timeless, but a followup is finally coming. The band — led by Faith No More's Roddy Bottum — is releasing All Over You this fall, and the lead single "Overdrive" is out now. items.title: June McDoom Announces Debut Album Follow The Light: Hear “Without You”
items.summary: For the past few years, the New York-based singer-songwriter known as June McDoom has been making spacey, elegant indie-folk. McDoom grew up in a Jamaican family in South Florida, absorbing reggae and folk, before moving to New York to study jazz performance. She started putting out her own music in 2022, and she collected her early EPs on a self-titled compilation last year.

items.title: O Slow Announces Debut Album Antenna: Hear “No Body” & “Shine”
items.summary: Brooklyn-based Jacqui Miranda makes ethereal alt-pop under the moniker O Slow. She's been dropping singles for a few years now, and last year she released the EP Night Shine, Through Me. In September, we'll have her first full-length album, Antenna — and actually we have 22% of it now.
